tex_content.html:
Theorem
[Hölder estimate for weak divergence-form solutions]1. ch15:15.7\group ch15-global-interior-gradient Let $u\in C^1(\Omega )$ be a weak solution of (15.56) and assume (15.76). For $B_0=B_{R_0}(y)\subset \Omega $ and $R\leq R_0$,

egin{equation} ag {15.77} \osc _{B_R(y)} u \leq C(1+R_0^{-\alpha }M_0)R^\alpha \end{equation}

where $C=C(n,a_0,b_0, u _0,\chi ,R_0,m,M_0)$ and $\alpha =\alpha (n,a_0,b_0, u _0,m,M_0)>0$, with $M_0=\sup _{B_0}|u|$.

Proof

\sketch For

\[ k=\chi (R+R^{m/(m-1)}) \]

the weak Harnack argument gives

egin{equation} ag {15.78} R^{-n/p}\| u\| _{L^p(B_{2R}(y))}\leq C igl(\inf _{B_R(y)} u+k igr) \end{equation}

where $C=C(n,a_0,b_0, u _0,m,M_0,p)$ and $1\le p<n/(n-m)^+$. Use the test function

\[ \varphi =\eta ^m ar{u}^{ eta } \exp (-b_0 ar{u}), \qquad eta <0, \]

in $\mathcal Q(u,\varphi )\ge 0$, followed by Sobolev (7.26) and oscillation iteration (Theorem 8.22), to obtain (15.77).

□
